turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Happy New Year, Marcus! How is your Friday starting out in Portland?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Happy New Year! It's starting out pretty quiet. I just finished breakfast, actually. Just had a quick protein smoothie to get some energy.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: A protein smoothie is a great way to kick off the first day of 2027! Do you have any plans to get active today, or is it more of a rest day?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, definitely getting active. I'm actually about to head out for a session with some gym weights. I want to start the year strong.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Lifting gym weights is a perfect way to do that. How have things been with your tennis games lately, by the way? Have you and Grace been playing much?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Not as much tennis lately because of the winter weather, but Grace and I are hoping to get back on the court soon. We've mostly been focusing on planning our Japan trip for the spring.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That trip to Japan is going to be amazing! Have you guys made any progress on the itinerary?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, we've been looking at hotels in Tokyo and Kyoto. Grace is really excited about seeing the gardens there. Speaking of gardens, our neighbor's vegetable garden is looking a bit bare this winter, but they're already planning for spring too.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Winter is definitely a quiet time for gardens, but planning is half the fun! How is everything going at the high school? I imagine you have a bit of a winter break right now before heading back to the science department.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Exactly, we've had a nice break. It's been great to step away from the science department duties for a couple of weeks, though I'll have to start prep work again pretty soon.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Enjoy these last few days of peace! Have you had any time to get into your woodworking shop during the break?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I did a little bit of sanding on a side table yesterday, but tonight I think I'm just going to relax. Grace and I are planning to just wind down and watch some sitcom reruns on TV.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a perfectly cozy Friday evening. Sitcom reruns are the best for a low-key night. I hope you have a great workout with the gym weights and a relaxing evening!

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks! I'll catch up with you tomorrow. Have a good one!
